title: STF Alleges JeM Operatives Planned Terror Attack During Student Protest at Jantar Mantar
summary: The West Bengal Special Task Force (STF) claimed that JeM operatives allegedly planned a terror attack during a student protest at Jantar Mantar in Kolkata. The STF said the plan was to target Suvendu, a BJP leader, and sabotage the protest. Police claimed they had arrested a suspected Jaish operative who was involved in the plot. The suspect, identified as Mohammed Sirajuddin, was allegedly planning to target Suvendu's residence and disrupt the protest. The STF said the plan was foiled after they received information about the plot. The police also seized explosives and other materials from the suspect's possession.
summary_points: The West Bengal Special Task Force (STF) claimed that JeM operatives allegedly planned a terror attack during a student protest at Jantar Mantar in Kolkata.
